title: Two equivalent formulas disagree
hook: Two equivalent formulas disagree. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Arithmetic, function evaluation, vector dot products, small matrices and solving linear equations.
doesNotKnow: Avoid catastrophic subtraction in a quadratic root by computing one stable root and using the root product.

misconception: Algebraically equal formulas give equally accurate floating-point roots.
objective: Avoid catastrophic subtraction in a quadratic root by computing one stable root and using the root product.

claims.text: Adding same-sign quantities forms the stable large root without subtracting nearly equal numbers. The product relation then recovers the small root, avoiding cancellation in the direct small-root formula.
